title: Pipe run with bent elbows and flanges
purpose: Sweep a pipe along a polyline of corner points, replacing every corner by a tangent elbow of a given bend radius, with a twist-free section and optional flanges at the ends and joints. Use it for plumbing, industrial plants, sci-fi corridors and cable conduits.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Centreline corners as x,y,z separated by semicolons.

parameters.name: bend_radius
parameters.description: Centreline radius of every elbow; at least the pipe radius.

parameters.name: bend_segments
parameters.description: Segments along a 90 degree elbow; other angles scale.

parameters.name: flanges
parameters.description: Add flanges at both ends and at every elbow joint.

parameters.name: flange_ratio
parameters.description: Flange radius divided by the pipe radius.

outputs.description: One smooth-shaded closed mesh object named Pipe Run.

limits: Solid pipe without an inner bore; the wall thickness is not modelled. Elbows are circular arcs of one bend radius; tees, reducers and valves are not generated. Flanges are plain cylinders that overlap the pipe rather than being merged with it. A path that turns back on itself, or a run shorter than its two elbows need, is refused. Verified in Blender 5.2.1; written for the 4.2 API.
technique_references: Tangent arc fillet: tangent length R tan(theta / 2), centre on the bisector
Rotation-minimising frames by the double reflection method (Wang et al. 2008)
Rodrigues rotation for points on the elbow arc
